description: Conformance vectors for H6022 over cloud. Every SDK — the Rust core, its bindings and any hand-written port — must produce exactly these bodies for these arguments. See ../README.md.

vectors.name: power on
vectors.source: sent to the control endpoint on a live account, and the lamp lit at the brightness it had stored; no capture file

vectors.name: power off
vectors.source: sent to the control endpoint on a live account, and the lamp went dark; no capture file

vectors.name: brightness 100%
vectors.source: sent to the control endpoint on a live account, and the lamp went to full and read back 100; no capture file

vectors.name: brightness 1%, the lowest the API takes
vectors.source: sent to the control endpoint on a live account, and the lamp went to its minimum and read back 1; no capture file

vectors.name: colour red, packed into one integer
vectors.source: sent to the control endpoint on a live account, and the lamp painted every ring red; no capture file

vectors.name: colour blue, the low channel
vectors.source: sent to the control endpoint on a live account, and the lamp painted every ring blue; no capture file

vectors.name: colour temperature 2700 K, the warm bound
vectors.source: sent to the control endpoint on a live account, and the lamp went warm white and read back 2700; no capture file

vectors.name: colour temperature 6500 K, the cold bound
vectors.source: sent to the control endpoint on a live account, and the lamp went cold white and read back 6500; no capture file

vectors.name: status request
vectors.source: docs/protocol/cloud.md, the documented API; no capture

vectors.name: segment colour over the three zones at the base
vectors.source: sent to the control endpoint on a live account, and the lamp lit zones 0 to 2 red at the base and left the rest blue; no capture file

vectors.name: segment colour over the three zones at the top
vectors.source: sent to the control endpoint on a live account, and the lamp lit zones 12 to 14 green at the top and left the rest blue; no capture file

vectors.name: segment colour holds a zone once, in ascending order
vectors.source: docs/protocol/cloud.md, the documented API; no capture

vectors.name: music effect 3, the lowest value the API declares
vectors.source: sent to the control endpoint on a live account, and the lamp played and reacted to sound; no capture file

vectors.name: music effect 6, the highest value the API declares
vectors.source: sent to the control endpoint on a live account, and the lamp played and reacted to sound; no capture file
